about: The saved game regression (tests/run_regression.py): each case runs tests/saves/<name>.sav for its game days in tutankhamun_sim and compares the result with tests/reference/<name>.sav. The saves are players' cities from Pharaoh Heaven (source); the game's own files are not in the repository.

cases.name: rostja-pyramids
cases.covers: pyramids under construction, quarries and mines, two communities

cases.name: kerma-invasions
cases.covers: six companies, walls and towers, Kushite invasions

cases.name: atlantis-trade
cases.covers: canals, heavy sea trade, a city of 40000

cases.name: baki-temples
cases.covers: an Osiris temple complex, the gods, palatial estates, sea imports

cases.name: abu-ferry
cases.covers: an island city with a ferry, Very Hard

cases.name: avaris-tomb
cases.covers: a royal tomb and burial provisions
